commits.message:
Bootstrap shared gh-aw PR review templates and mise pinning (#1)

## Summary
- add shared PR review templates (`gh-aw-pr-review`, `gh-aw-pr-rereview`) with shared review rubric imports
- add reusable review guidance in `.github/snippets/code-review.md` and `.github/agents/code-review.md`
- add `mise.toml`-based `gh-aw` pinning (`GH_AW_VERSION`) plus convenience tasks (`aw-version`, `aw-validate`, `aw-compile`)
- document install/update/version-sync workflow in `README.md`

## Notes
- templates currently import `pulumi-labs/gh-aw-internal/.github/snippets/code-review.md@main` for consumer repos
- this PR includes compiled lockfiles and `.gitattributes`
commits.attribution_evidence: no supported agent signature in commit metadata

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+---
+description: Automated PR review for trusted internal contributors.
+timeout-minutes: 15
+strict: true
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      pr_number:
+        description: "Pull request number to review"
+        required: true
+        type: string
+imports:
+  - pulumi-labs/gh-aw-internal/.github/snippets/code-review.md@main
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  pull-requests: read
+  id-token: write
+engine:
+  id: claude
+  env:
+    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ steps.esc-secrets.outputs.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || '__GH_AW_ACTIVATION_PLACEHOLDER__' }}
+steps:
+  - env:
+      ESC_ACTION_ENVIRONMENT: imports/github-secrets
+      ESC_ACTION_EXPORT_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES: "false"
+      ESC_ACTION_OIDC_AUTH: "true"
+      ESC_ACTION_OIDC_ORGANIZATION: pulumi
+      ESC_ACTION_OIDC_REQUESTED_TOKEN_TYPE: urn:pulumi:token-type:access_token:organization
+    id: esc-secrets
+    name: Fetch secrets from ESC
+    uses: pulumi/esc-action@9eb774255b1a4afb7855678ae8d4a77359da0d9b
+  - name: Validate ESC secret output
+    env:
+      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_FROM_ESC: ${{ steps.esc-secrets.outputs.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
+    run: |
+      test -n "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_FROM_ESC" || {
+        echo "ESC did not return ANTHROPIC_API_KEY";
+        exit 1;
+      }
+tools:
+  github:
+    lockdown: false
+    toolsets: [pull_requests, repos]
+safe-outputs:
+  create-pull-request-review-comment:
+    max: 12
+    side: "RIGHT"
+    target: "${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }}"
+    target-repo: "${{ github.repository }}"
+  submit-pull-request-review:
+    max: 1
+    target: "${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }}"
+  noop:
+    max: 1
+  messages:
+    footer: "> Reviewed by [{workflow_name}]({run_url})"
+    run-started: "Started automated PR review for #${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }}."
+    run-success: "Finished automated PR review for #${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }}."
+    run-failure: "Automated PR review failed for #${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }} ({status})."
+---
+
+# Internal Trusted PR Reviewer
+
+Review pull request #${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }} in repository `${{ github.repository }}`.
+This workflow imports `pulumi-labs/gh-aw-internal/.github/snippets/code-review.md@main` for the baseline review rubric.
+
+## Trust Model
+
+This workflow supports both `pull_request` and manual `workflow_dispatch` triggers.
+For `pull_request`, it uses gh-aw default fork filtering (same-repository PRs only unless `forks` is explicitly configured).
+`tools.github.lockdown: false` is set to avoid requiring a custom GitHub MCP token.
+If required PR context cannot be read in this trust model, call `noop` with a brief reason and stop.
+
+## Workflow-Specific Rules
+
+- Use `${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }}` as the authoritative PR target.
+- Ignore discovery steps intended for runs without PR context.
+- Use `create-pull-request-review-comment` for actionable inline findings on changed lines.
+- Submit exactly one final review with `submit-pull-request-review`:
+  - `REQUEST_CHANGES` for blocking issues.
+  - `COMMENT` for non-blocking observations.
+  - `APPROVE` when no actionable issues remain.
+- If there is nothing to do because trust/context checks fail, call `noop`.
+
+Constraints:
+- Post no more than 12 inline comments.
+- Do not post free-form issue comments outside review safe outputs.

commits.message:
Enforce binary final PR review states (#2)

## Summary
- Update shared review policy to use binary final states only: `REQUEST_CHANGES` when blocking issues exist, otherwise `APPROVE`
- Explicitly forbid submitting `COMMENT` as the final review state
- Apply the same wording in both workflow and shared snippet to prevent policy drift
- Include `.gitignore` with local runtime/command/log directories
- Commit regenerated `gh-aw` import cache and lockfiles produced by compile

## Validation
- `mise run aw-validate`
- `mise run aw-compile`

commits.message:
Refactor shared PR review workflows (#3)

## Summary
- refactor the PR review workflows to import a shared review contract
and local reviewer prompt
- move the detailed review procedure into
`.github/workflows/shared/plugins/code-review/code-review.md` and enable
cache-memory-backed review continuity
- update the README to document the new shared review layout and
maintenance flow

## Verification
- gh aw compile gh-aw-pr-review
- gh aw compile gh-aw-pr-rereview

commits.message:
Upgrade gh-aw and improve review workflow behavior (#4)

## Summary
- upgrade the pinned `gh-aw` version to `v0.65.6` and regenerate the
compiled lockfiles
- trigger the main PR review workflow on both `opened` and
`ready_for_review`
- tighten the shared code-review prompt to prefer terse, issue-only
reviews and avoid repeating inline comments in the final review
- add `resolve-pull-request-review-thread` support so rereviews can
resolve stale bot-authored threads that are fixed or clearly
acknowledged

## Verification
- `mise run aw-version`
- `mise run aw-validate`
- `mise run aw-compile`

commits.message:
Upgrade gh-aw review workflows (#9)

## Summary
- Upgrade gh-aw to v0.76.1 and regenerate review workflow lockfiles.
- Consolidate review prompt behavior into the shared code-review prompt
and remove legacy duplicate prompt files.
- Allow manual draft PR reviews and support both `/review-again` and
`/review` slash commands.

## Notes
- Final review guidance now uses `APPROVE` or `COMMENT`, never
`REQUEST_CHANGES`.
- The upgrade adds the generated gh-aw agent helper and Copilot setup
workflow from upstream gh-aw.

## Validation
- `mise run aw-validate && mise run aw-compile && git diff --check`

Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>
